lede: Carolina had last change, so Rod Brind'Amour picked most of these matchups. Carolina played without Juuso Välimäki and Nicolas Deslauriers. Chicago played without Ethan Del Mastro and Patrick Kane.

notes.head: The fourth line drew Smith’s line
notes.text: Rod Brind'Amour sent Robinson, Kotkaniemi and Martinook out for 8:33 of their 11:48 at 5-on-5 against Boucher, Greenway and Smith (72%, about 20% with no line matching), and they had the better of the chances, 0.40 to 0.18 expected goals. Carolina scored one of its nine goals then.

notes.head: The third line drew Teräväinen’s line
notes.text: Hall, Jankowski and Jarvis spent 8:39 of their 14:22 at 5-on-5 against Teräväinen, Greene and Donato (60%, about 27% with no line matching), and they had the better of the chances, 0.75 to 0.07 expected goals.

notes.head: Aho’s line drew Bedard’s line
notes.text: Carrier, Aho and Svechnikov spent 8:49 of their 13:56 at 5-on-5 against Kantserov, Bedard and Bertuzzi (63%, about 31% with no line matching), and they had the better of the chances, 0.83 to 0.22 expected goals. Carolina scored two of its nine goals then.

foot: Rod Brind'Amour matched about as hard as in his other home games: each line spent 60% of its time against one opposing line, against 38% to 78% in his first seven.
